chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Bashir, from Ubayd Allah ibn al-Dihqan, from Durust, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who recites Al-hakum at-takathur at sleep-time would be saved from the strife of the grave.'

key_terms.أَلْهَيكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ: Abundance diverts you (opening phrase of Surah Al-Takathur)

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of reciting Surah Al-Takathur before sleeping?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith establishes a specific devotional practice of reciting Surah Al-Takathur before sleep to ward off the trials of the grave (fitnat al-qabr). This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on the Quran's protective power against post-mortem spiritual challenges, linking the worldly distraction of accumulation mentioned in the Surah to the eternal accountability of the grave.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ja.far Bin Muhammad Bin Bashir, from Ubeydullah Bin Al Dihqan, from Dorost, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The one who recites [102:1] (Abundance diverts you) at sleep-time would be saved from the strife of the grave’.
en.sarwar: 14. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Bashir from ‘Ubayd Allah ibn al-Dihqan from Drust from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Whoever read al-Hakum al-Takathur Chapter 102 of the Holy Quran at bedtime will be safe from the mischief of the grave.’”
